Name: Simple Screenshots
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
By default, this mod takes a screenshot when you press [b]F9[/b].

If that key is taken by another mod or screenshot app, you can change it in the config using Generic Mod Config Menu or editing the mod's config.json file.

Screenshots are saved in your SDV folder under Screenshots. Files are named by save name and real time stamp.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires SDV 1.5.5+

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], doesn't use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
